ipeds.title: IPEDS Admissions survey, fall 2023 entering class (ADM2023), via College Navigator

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class): 5,184 applied, 3,521 admitted, 846 enrolled. No readable Common Data Set was found on Lander's site, so GPA, international applicant/admit counts and SAT total are not available. Newer College Navigator figures (fall 2024): 4,565 applicants, about 81% admitted (rounded %), 3,776 undergraduates (used for enrollment here). Test optional; students submitting SAT/ACT are a minority.
